meta.name: syn3a_core
meta.note_zh: 每個參數都帶 source；source 以 CATALOG id + DOI 標示，非文獻值一律標 ESTIMATE-UNMEASURED 或 ASSUMED-TEXTBOOK/DERIVED。
meta.note_en: Every parameter carries a source. Non-literature values are tagged ESTIMATE-UNMEASURED or ASSUMED-TEXTBOOK/DERIVED.

genome_bp.source: C0715 10.7554/elife.36842 'chromosome of a 543,379 bp genome in a 400 nm spherical cell'

n_mrna_genes_full.source: C0862 'degrade all 452 mRNA, and translate all 452 mRNA into proteins'

ribosome_active_fraction.source: C0862 'on average, 220 of the 503 ribosomes, roughly 45% of ribosomes, are active'

cell_radius_nm.source: C0715 '400 nm spherical cell' (diameter) -> radius 200 nm

doubling_time_experimental_s.source: C0715/C0862 'JCVI-syn3A has a doubling time of 105 min'

tx_elongation_nt_per_s.source: C5382 10.3389/fmolb.2019.00130 'of 25 nt/s are used for kcat'

tl_elongation_aa_per_s.source: C5382 'with an elongation rate of 2 aa/sec'

mrna_half_life_s.source: C5382 'A messenger halflife of 4 min is used for all mRNA degradation'

atp_per_bp_replication.source: C0862 'DNA replication uses 1 ATP as an energy molecule per bp'

atp_fraction_precursor_transport.source: C0715 'only spend 9% of its produced ATP on precursor transport and processing'

surface_area_contribution_ratio.source: C0862 'maintain a rough 55% to 45% surface area contribution ratio'

atp_per_glucose_glycolysis.source: ASSUMED-TEXTBOOK net glycolysis yield; C0862 states syn3A 'depends almost entirely on glycolysis for formation of ATP'

atp_per_nt_transcription.source: ASSUMED-TEXTBOOK (NTP polymerisation ~2 high-energy phosphates per nt)

atp_per_aa_translation.source: ASSUMED-TEXTBOOK (2 ATP charging + 2 GTP elongation per peptide bond)

k_glucose_per_transporter_per_s.source: ESTIMATE-UNMEASURED (set so ATP supply exceeds demand; verified by the gate M2 shortfall check)

k_lipid_per_enzyme_per_s.source: CALIBRATED-TO-C0715-DOUBLING-TIME (geometric bisection so the median doubling time = 105 min; tools/run_cell_sim.py calibrate, Jetson 2026-11-22). Not an independent prediction.

k_replication_bp_per_s.source: ESTIMATE-UNMEASURED (replisome rate; syn3A value not in the local library)

atp_km.source: ESTIMATE-UNMEASURED (Michaelis constant on ATP for biosynthesis)

n_core_genes.source: Plan 44 D4 decision: core subset of 50-100 genes

protein_per_mrna_class_fraction.source: DERIVED gene class split 20/20/10/10 of 60 core genes

communication_step_s.source: C0862 'we used a communication time step of 1 s'
